preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 20,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Number of bosses in each test case is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(a_i in [0, 1] for a_i in a) for a in as_)
preconditions.description: Each boss type is either 0 (easy) or 1 (hard).

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(skip_points, int) and skip_points >= 0 for skip_points in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of skip points needed.
